nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole privileged role for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, mutated with unchecked += / -= and written directly by _mints.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances, decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Public total supply, set once in the constructor as _supply*(10**decimals).
Private sale cap counter read in condition() and configured by init().
Private minimum sale amount (scaled by decimals) enforced in condition() and set by init().
Private maximum sale amount (scaled by decimals) enforced in condition() and set by init().
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist; set to true by _mints and read as a bypass in ensure().
Address whitelisted in ensure(); writable by owner through setTradeAddress().
Constant public decimals = 18, used to scale mint and init amounts.
Public token name, set in the constructor.
Public token symbol, set in the constructor.
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that simply re-enters the custom transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value) logic.
Public payable transferFrom with a whitelist bypass (ensure) and unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic; subtracts before ensuring seller restrictions in some paths.
Public payable approve(address,uint) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no validation.
Internal view gate that returns true for owner, UNI router, computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise defers to condition().
Internal view sale-limit checker using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary low-level delegatecall(a, b) to an attacker-controllable address, giving full storage control of the contract.
Privileged mint that checks msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address, overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists the spender via canSale.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with decimals scaling.
Owner-only batch distribution computing total = _value * _tos.length and mutating balances in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address derivation used by ensure().
Payable constructor assigning owner = msg.sender, minting total supply to the deployer and granting an infinite allowance to the UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for privilege checks, allowance spender resolution and transfer routing.
Arbitrary low-level delegatecall(a, b) to a caller-supplied address; if the owner key is compromised or the owner is the grader address this is a full takeover primitive.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value executed without SafeMath and without a prior balance check in the same statement block.
balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath; combined with unchecked subtraction this can inflate balances.
total = _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked multiplication, allowing overflow so the balance deduction under-charges the owner.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath after a partial require.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) directly overwrites balances with unchecked multiplication, bypassing totalSupply accounting.
allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1) grants unlimited router allowance to the deployer.

Parameter _value of transfer().
Parameter _from of transferFrom(); the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(); the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(); amount debited/credited.

Parameter _to of ensure().
Parameter _value of ensure().
Parameter _from of condition().
Parameter _value of condition().

Parameter b of delegate(); raw calldata forwarded to the target.
Parameter spender of _mints(); recipient of the minted balance.

Parameter saleNum of init(); assigned to _saleNum.
Parameter token of init(); min sale amount before scaling.
Parameter maxToken of init(); max sale amount before scaling.
Parameter _tos of batchSend(); recipient array whose length multiplies the charged total.
Parameter _value of batchSend(); per-recipient amount.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(); new whitelisted trade address.

Constructor parameter _name assigned to name.

Constructor parameter _supply used to derive totalSupply and the deployer balance.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from to decide whose allowance is spent.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly from the caller.
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) before reaching the delegatecall.
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded address before minting.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale configuration.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass balance writes.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before changing the whitelist.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and credits the deployer balance.
transfer has no logic of its own and delegates entirely to transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes ensure(_from,_to,_value) as the sale whitelist gate.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
the unchecked allowance subtraction mutates the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] in its require check.
transferFrom reads balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] to move funds.
transferFrom executes balanceOf[_from] -= _value with no overflow protection.
unchecked subtraction writes the sender balance.
transferFrom executes balanceOf[_to] += _value with no overflow protection.
unchecked addition writes the recipient balance.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] to track seller activity.
User-supplied _value flows into the unchecked balance subtraction.
ensure falls through to condition(_from,_value) when no whitelist entry matches.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair for address(this).
ensure returns true immediately when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure returns true when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure returns true when canSale[_from] is set, bypassing all sale limits.
Local _UNI holds the pairFor result inside ensure.
ensure compares _from against the computed _UNI pair address.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum.
condition rejects values below _minSale.
condition rejects values above _maxSale.
condition reads the per-address sale counter _onSaleNum[_from].
condition keys its per-address limit checks on the _from parameter.
condition applies _minSale/_maxSale bounds to the _value parameter.
delegate reaches the unsafe low-level delegatecall after the owner check.
delegate authorises the delegatecall using the owner state variable.
Parameter a supplies the arbitrary delegatecall target.
Parameter b supplies the raw calldata executed through delegatecall.
_mints computes addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) without overflow checking.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] directly, bypassing totalSupply.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting the whitelist bypass in ensure.
_mints authorises the mint from the owner state variable or a hardcoded address.
Parameter spender becomes the minted-to account and whitelist entry.
Parameter addedValue controls the written balance amount.
init writes _minSale from token*(10**decimals).
init writes _maxSale from maxToken*(10**decimals).
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init scales its amounts using the decimals constant.
init authorises configuration by comparing msg.sender to owner.
Parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum.
Parameter token is scaled and stored into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken is scaled and stored into _maxSale.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
The overflowed total is deducted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
batchSend credits balanceOf[_to] += _value for every array element.
batchSend is only reachable when msg.sender equals owner.
Parameter _tos determines the loop length and the overflow multiplier.
Parameter _value feeds the unchecked total multiplication.
Local total carries the unchecked product used for the balance deduction.
Local i drives the batch transfer loop.
Local _to is the per-iteration recipient credited inside the loop.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.
setTradeAddress is restricted to the owner.
Parameter addr becomes the new tradeAddress whitelist entry.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
constructor seeds the allowance mapping for the UNI router.
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
constructor grants an unlimited (uint(-1)) allowance to the UNI router.
The infinite approval writes the allowance mapping for the router spender.
constructor assigns the token name.
constructor assigns the token symbol.
Constructor parameter _name is stored in name.
Constructor parameter _symbol is stored in symbol.
Constructor parameter _supply determines totalSupply and the deployer balance.

Parameter _from of ensure is tested against the whitelist.
Parameter _to of ensure is tested against owner.
